notes.title: Update: Gamepad Support & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We’re continuing to improve your gameplay experience!
This update introduces full gamepad support — now you can enjoy the game from the comfort of your couch with your favorite controller.
We’ve also fixed several minor bugs to make your journey smoother and more immersive.

🔧 What’s New:
• Full support for gamepads (Xbox, DualShock, and others)
• Control optimization
• Minor bug fixes and technical improvements

[h3]Thanks for staying with us — more updates are on the way![/h3]

notes.title: New monsters, fixes, and the grand finale!
notes.content:
🔥 What's new in this update? 🔥

✅ [b]Ending added[/b] – now you can witness the conclusion of your story!
✅ [b]New Monster Introduced[/b] – another terrifying creature awaits you.
✅ [b]Brightness issues fixed[/b] – lighting now works correctly.
✅ [b]Collision bugs fixed[/b] – interactions with the environment are now more precise.
✅ [b]Save bugs fixed[/b] – no more issues with progress loss.
✅ [b]New languages added[/b] – the game is now available in Portuguese, Spanish, German, and French!

[h2]And That’s Not All![/h2]

👌 In the near future, we plan to add support for Japanese, Chinese, and Korean languages to bring the world of Foul Bliss to even more players. Stay tuned for updates!

[h3]Stay Tuned for More Updates![/h3]
